Acid: Crime drama. Lieutenant Van Buren cuts corners when trying to track down the assailant who threw acid in the face of her friend's daughter (10/22).
Bible Story: American drama series about lawyers and police. A man is mysteriously killed after he desecrates a treasured edition of the Hebrew Torah in a synagogue (11/22).
Family Friend: US crime drama series. When a murdered accountant's mob connections are exposed, the detectives are drawn into the shady underbelly of the NYPD (12/22).

Hit and Run: American crime drama. The NCIS team investigates a Marine's car accident and ignites some upsetting memories for Abby as a young girl on the trail of her first case.

US crime drama. After Harper Dearing's bombing of the NCIS headquarters, Gibbs goes on the hunt to find the criminal mastermind.

Heart of Darkness: Crime drama. McCoy prosecutes a woman who helped her boyfriend to die. But the case becomes more complex when it emerges that a third person was involved (13/22).

Canary: Crime drama. The NCIS team takes on a renowned hacker who could hold the key to tracking down the most-wanted cyber-terrorist in the world.
Hereafter: US naval police drama. On leave from NCIS while still grieving, director Vance discovers unexpected personal information that causes him to question everything.
US naval police drama. The NCIS team races to track down Ducky and Jimmy after the two disappear while transporting a body from a crime scene.
